snippet.title: NSMBWii Superstar Mode: NSMB Modding Direct 2025 Trailer
snippet.description:
New Super Mario Bros. Wii Superstar Mode is a NSMBWer+ Mod that aims to turn the loved and well known game into a much more challenging and add a creative feel to the original game. After the continuous defeats, Bowser Jr decided to put mario back through his past in an alternative reality, a harder reality. Mario & Co. Have to beat Bowser Jr in order to escape this reality going through the 8 Worlds once again. Stop Bowser Jr before the reality becomes the only reality Mario & Co. Will know for the rest of their lives.


This trailer shows most of the New Stuff we've made for the mod since the Demo release Trailer. Speaking of, You can play the Demo of the mod here:

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1KtdeskhRaR8kCfrRR-Wo5dKl4U0Y3INe


This mod is made by the Dread Modders team, Who have no affiliation with Nintendo and we do not endorse Piracy and heavily discourage pirating.
